entries.title: Missing serde derive feature
entries.root_cause: The serde dependency lacks the derive feature required by the KeelHeader derive macros.

entries.title: Missing clap derive feature
entries.root_cause: The clap dependency lacks its derive feature required by the KeelArgs parser macro.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same derive-macro error concerns clap instead of serde; enabling clap's derive feature fixes it.

entries.title: Missing sqlx macros feature
entries.root_cause: The sqlx dependency lacks its macros feature required by the KeelRow derive macro.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same derive-macro error concerns sqlx; enabling its macros feature fixes it.

entries.title: Absent schema directory
entries.root_cause: The workflow points the schema check at a directory that does not exist in the checkout.
